test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No Improvement'.**

The apple tree was __loaded of__ fruit.
solution:
The correct answer is **laden with**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Laden: **having or carrying a lot of something.

 
 
• **Example: **The trucks are **laden with** vegetables. 
 
 
 
• The word **laden **is an **adjective **here.
 
• The preposition** 'with' **is used with **laden**.
 
• Hence, the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence is **option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *The apple tree was __**laden with**__ fruit.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

 
• The connotation when you say **"the tree was loaded with fruit**" is **positive**: the tree is full of fruit, which means there's plenty to go around. When you say **"the tree was laden with fruit"**, it's implying that the tree's branches are weighed down by their burden of fruit.
 
• The answer given by SSC is **'laden with'.**
